purpose: Test numerical stability of the already fitted marker-history prediction result, following the user's request to establish spatial convergence.
status: Frozen before new refinement simulations; exploratory follow-up after seeing the original pilot.
pilot: Run seed 1024 at grid 56 first; verify source/configuration hashes, finite arrays, CFL, incompressibility and energy budget before continuing.
invariants: Unchanged parent Navier-Stokes solver, smooth Fourier initial-condition realization, marker initial positions, Heun method, domain side 6, zero force, viscosity, prediction anchors, lookback, horizon, delay, training-derived event threshold, feature code and trained model coefficients. Original sharp strain/tube matrix is read-only and not expanded.
learning: No fitting, selection, re-quantiling, or model tuning on refinement runs. Seeds are the same eight held-out groups, not eight additional independent groups.
comparisons: event-set Jaccard and flip fraction at the original training-derived threshold
paired per-run A/B RMSE and average precision with bootstrap intervals
time-step differences on the first two prechosen test seeds
screens_interpretation: Operational numerical-stability screens for this follow-up, not a theorem or universal tolerance. A predictive claim additionally needs the A/B effect to survive refinement and numerical changes small enough to resolve that effect. A shrinking difference alone does not establish an asymptotic range or warrant Richardson extrapolation.
limits: These are smooth-flow pilot refinements, not validation of the original nonsmooth strain/tube start. Frozen coarse-trained predictors assess transfer/stability, not optimum fine-grid-trained predictive power. The target is deformation along a material trajectory over a delayed window; it is not exact Eulerian event onset/location.
